profile.headline: QA Engineer | Manual Testing | API Testing | SQL | Exploring Test Automation
profile.summary: I’m a driven individual ready to dive into new projects and work with a diverse team to meet your mission and goals!

positions.title: Backend Developer & QA Engineer
positions.description:
Conduct manual testing for backend APIs, ensuring data integrity and application reliability.
Design and execute test cases to validate REST API responses and support development teams in resolving defects.
Utilize SQL (MySQL, MariaDB) to verify data changes, debug issues, and perform backend testing.
Analyze application logs using Rollbar, ArgoCD, and New Relic to monitor performance, identify anomalies, and ensure system stability.
Track and manage defects in Jira, collaborating with developers to streamline bug resolution and improve release quality.
Assist backend development efforts by debugging, implementing bug fixes, and enhancing features in PHP Symfony.
Currently exploring automation testing to improve test coverage and efficiency using Selenium WebDriver and CI/CD integration.
positions.insights: Skills: Bug Tracking · API Testing · Manual Testing · MySQL

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
**Position under Caliburn company: CHS Medical
- Worked extensively in python’s Django framework building simple web apps to assist internal employees in monitoring and managing company incident reports and receiving client applications.
- Features developed include form submission, CRUD to update records for explicit user roles, and dashboard views to display data with additional search functionality such as pagination and filtering.
positions.insights: Skills: MariaDB · Python (Programming Language) · Django · jQuery · Scss

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Worked as part of an Agile team to develop new features and maintain various internal and customer-facing web products for high school sports.
- Some examples of tasks done include email notifications for fundraising campaigns, Google DFP ads management, bug fixes, recreating views from mock-ups, and more.
- Primarily worked in PHP for tasks that involved internal REST API.  Client-side tasks ranged widely from a mix of technologies such as React/NextJs, Wordpress, AngularJs, and more.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · MySQL · PHP · SASS · Nextjs · NestJS · Symphony · GraphQL

positions.title: Sales Specialist, Logistics
positions.description:
Working Part-time as part of the Logistics Team and Sales Specialist. 
As logistics, my duties are to receive freight and stock in the store in a timely and well-organized manner. 
As a Sales Specialist, my duties are to assist our customers with their needs offering products and services to best match their personal or business needs.

positions.title: Customer Service Advocate
positions.description:
At United, I worked servicing our retirees with their Medicare insurance plans provided by their Group employer.  
As a customer service advocate, it was my responsibility to go above and beyond to assist our members with their concerns or issues.
Reaching out to provider's offices for questions on claim disputes, services, appointments, and in network availability were some of the many ways we assisted our members with their insurance plans.
